data.name: For Her Crown
data.detailed_description:
The kingdom has fallen. The crown remains.

You are a knight who refused to abandon his oath.

With the kingdom in ruins and only a handful of survivors left, the last hope of its people rests with the Queen. Your task is simple but far from easy: survive, rebuild, and prepare the way for the kingdom's return.

Explore a dangerous medieval dark fantasy world, fight hostile factions, raid enemy camps, gather valuable resources, and bring what you find back to your stronghold. Every expedition is a risk. The farther you venture, the greater the rewards and the greater the danger on the journey home.

Build and expand your castle from the ground up. Turn a fragile refuge into a fortified stronghold, unlock new capabilities, recruit forces, and create a place where the remaining survivors can endure.

But rebuilding is only half the battle.

As your stronghold grows, so do the threats around it. Defend what you have built, secure the surrounding lands, and push back the forces that claimed your kingdom.

Every run brings a changing world, with different enemy camps, resources, encounters, and dangers. Fight your way through each expedition, return with what you can carry, and use your gains to strengthen your castle and prepare for the next challenge.

Explore. Fight. Loot. Rebuild. Defend. Reclaim.

The kingdom may be gone.

But your oath is not.

KEY FEATURES

  • Explore a Dangerous Medieval World

Venture beyond your stronghold and discover a world filled with hostile factions, valuable resources, and unpredictable dangers.

  • Third-Person Action Combat

Fight your enemies with swords, bows, magic, and spells.

  • Build and Expand Your Castle

Transform a fragile refuge into a powerful stronghold capable of supporting survivors and defending your lands.

  • Risk and Reward Expeditions

Raid enemy camps, gather valuable resources, and decide how far you are willing to push before returning home.

  • Bring Your Loot Home

Resources are only useful once they reach your stronghold. Survive the journey back and protect what you have earned.

  • Defend What You Build

As your stronghold grows, enemy factions may strike back. Build, prepare, and defend your home.

  • Dynamic Roguelite Runs

Enemy camps, resources, encounters, and dangers can change from run to run, making every expedition different.

  • A Growing Stronghold

Develop your castle, unlock new possibilities, recruit forces, and gradually rebuild the foundations of a lost kingdom.

  • A World of Rival Factions

Face Orcs, Bandits, enemy mages, and other hostile groups. Not every faction has to remain your enemy.

  • Day & Night Cycle

The changing world brings new conditions and new risks as day turns to night.

YOUR JOURNEY

Explore → Fight → Loot → Return → Build → Defend → Repeat

Venture into the unknown.

Fight through enemy territory.

Take what you can carry.

Make it back alive.

Use your gains to rebuild your stronghold.

Defend what you have created.

Then venture out again.

data.short_description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, protect its last survivors, and fight to reclaim what was lost. Explore a dangerous dark fantasy world, gather resources, build your stronghold, and fight for her crown.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Core i7-6700K or Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains fantasy violence, including third-person combat with swords, bows, magic, and spells. Players fight hostile humanoid and fantasy enemies, including Orcs, Bandits, and other hostile factions.
The story takes place in a dark fantasy setting involving the fall of a kingdom, death, conflict, and the protection of the remaining survivors.
